8.6.3.19 EventFailureCycleCounterThreshold
[SWS_Dem_91018] Definition of ClientServerInterface EventFailureCycleCounter
Threshold ⌈
Name
EventFailureCycleCounterThreshold
Comment
Provides the capability for dynamical adaptation of the failure cycle threshold. One port of this
interface is provided per diagnostic event with EventId as a port-defined argument.
IsService
true
Variation
(count({ecuc(Dem/DemConfigSet/DemEventParameter/DemEventConfirmationThreshold
CounterAdaptable)} == TRUE) > 0 )
0
E_OK
Operation successful
Possible Errors
